project_info.theme: Relaxed at-home IPL hair-removal lifestyle scene
project_info.color_palette: Warm White, Beige, Soft Gray, Skin Tones, Black

main_subject.detail: A relaxed lifestyle photo of a woman sitting on an unmade white bed wearing a white ribbed dress, towel-turban, and black sunglasses with a white face mask on, holding a Halio Sapphire IPL device while looking at her phone.
main_subject.style: Casual luxury self-care lifestyle ad, cozy bedroom beauty-tech photography

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'TRIỆT NHANH TOÀN THÂN CHỈ TRONG 10 PHÚT', 'Máy triệt lông lạnh đá Sapphire Halio IPL', 'Thương Hiệu Máy Triệt Lông SỐ 1 VIỆT NAM'.
items: Top Left: Neutral gray wall and soft bed-head backdrop.
Top Right: LIXIBOX logo in the upper corner and white pillows behind the seated model.
Bottom Left: Large white copy block about full-body hair removal in 10 minutes.
Bottom Right: Round silver brand-credibility badge reading 'SỐ 1 VIỆT NAM'.
Center/Background: Woman seated cross-legged on white bedding, holding a smartphone in one hand and the plugged-in Halio IPL device in the other with a blue light glowing at the base.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Cozy morning-room feel, gentle shadows, realistic self-care intimacy, muted premium calm

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for an at-home IPL hair-removal lifestyle scene. Centerpiece is a woman sitting on a white bed with a towel turban, black sunglasses, and white face mask, holding a Halio Sapphire IPL device while checking her phone. Background is a soft neutral bedroom with pillows and white bedding. Surrounding elements: headline 'TRIỆT NHANH TOÀN THÂN CHỈ TRONG 10 PHÚT', subline 'Máy triệt lông lạnh đá Sapphire Halio IPL', LIXIBOX logo, and a round badge 'Thương Hiệu Máy Triệt Lông SỐ 1 VIỆT NAM'. Keep the candid self-care pose and the plugged-in device with blue light. Technical style: high fidelity lifestyle photography, soft natural indoor lighting, cozy premium calm and gentle shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed face, extra limbs, watermark, signature, cropped
